verdict.rationale: Loops documents its own domain setup flow: a docs page titled 'Set up your domain to start sending email', and its migration guide lists 'verify your domain' as a cutover step. That shows first-party sending-domain configuration and verification, but neither mention names SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment or describes guided DNS records. Missing for 10: explicit SPF/DKIM/DMARC coverage, details of guided DNS record setup, a description of the verification status/check flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
